gloss: first ten days of a month; early part of a month

definitions.gloss: first ten days of a month; early part of a month
definitions.explanation: The first third of a month, roughly days 1-10. Part of a three-way division of the month into 初旬 (early), 中旬 (mid), and 下旬 (late). Composed of 初 (beginning) + 旬 (ten-day period).

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧{初旬|しょじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The meeting will be held in early April.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{六月|ろくがつ}→六月：00662_rokugatsu⟧{初旬|しょじゅん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The rainy season often begins in early June.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{初旬|しょじゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: The report deadline is scheduled for early next month.

notes:
USAGE:
{初旬|しょじゅん} is used in both formal and everyday contexts when specifying an approximate time within a month. It forms a set with ⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧ (mid-month, roughly days 11-20) and ⟦{下旬|げじゅん}→下旬：00062_gejun⟧ (late month, roughly days 21-end).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧{初旬|しょじゅん} (early [month])
- {初旬|しょじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in the early part of the month)
- {初旬|しょじゅん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the early part of the month)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{上旬|じょうじゅん}→上旬：17767_joujun⟧ is a synonym with the same meaning. {初旬|しょじゅん} and ⟦{上旬|じょうじゅん}→上旬：17767_joujun⟧ are interchangeable, though ⟦{上旬|じょうじゅん}→上旬：17767_joujun⟧ is slightly more common.
